description: Weak partial pattern: early game (ply <= 18), I moved first, no immediate win, and the bottom two rows of columns 2-3 form a checkerboard: column 2 empty or my stone capped by theirs, column 3 empty or their stone with mine on top. Odd column-2 heights, column-3 height 1, or the opposite colours switch it off. Other stones modulate it unpredictably.
effect: Weak and inconsistent: zeroing or maxing it shifts at most about 5-12 points, usually between columns 2, 3 and 4 (e.g. zeroing in pos 94550 moves 6 points from column 2 to column 3); often no measurable change.
notes: 6 score calls. Column-2 height 0/2 alone: F1 0.12; + column-3 condition 0.15; point rule 0.18; block score + me_first + no win 0.20; + ply<=18 0.214 (P .215 R .213, sim share 0.03). Minimal pairs confirm the col2/col3 bottom-block preference at even ply (4,4,1,1 family; 2,3,1,2,3,2 family) but parity, X at (0,4), and distant stones change activation nonlinearly; odd-ply firing exists on fuller boards and is not covered. Likely a mixture or distributed direction. Synthesis reaches 12.58 vs dev max 11.77.
